name: s3
description: S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, MinIO, SeaweedFS, ...).

fields.name: apiUrl
fields.label: API endpoint
fields.help: Leave the AWS regional endpoint out for AWS S3 itself; set it for MinIO, SeaweedFS and other S3-compatible servers.

fields.name: internalUrl
fields.label: Internal URL
fields.help: In-cluster address, used by workloads instead of going out through the ingress.

fields.name: accessKey
fields.label: Access key ID
fields.help: Stored in the credentials Secret alongside the secret key, as the s3 contract expects. An access key identifies a caller, it does not belong in a readable object.

fields.name: pathStyle
fields.label: Path-style addressing
fields.help: Required by most self-hosted S3 servers. AWS S3 uses virtual-host style.
